name: dsh-canvas-excalidraw-vendor
description: Build inputs for the vendored Excalidraw surface shipped inside dsh-canvas (lib/vendor/excalidraw/). Rebuild: npm install, then `node build.mjs` (see packages/dsh-canvas/README.md). Never published, and never shipped: a distribution carries lib/vendor/, and this folder's node_modules is skipped by scripts/dist-manifest.txt - the same bargain the vendored CodeMirror, pdf.js and mermaid trees make.
